title_zh: 约好更换弯曲的自行车前轮

scenario.goal_zh: 检查车况、讨论维修必要性并确认取车时间。

context_zh: 骑车人推着车到维修店，想确认车轮是否需要更换及何时能取车。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: The front wheel looks bent. Can it be repaired?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Let me check it on the stand. No, this rim needs replacing; I wouldn't ride on it.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Can you replace it today? I can leave the bike here.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Yes. The total would be forty pounds, and you could collect it at five.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: That works. Please replace it, and I'll come back at five.
